_comment: Condensed from the Apollo 11 CSM flight plan and checklists [adapted for this simulator]. Keys: V/N/Enter = VERB/NOUN/ENTR, Space = PRO. control: the cabin control a step is done on (an id in data/cockpit/controls.csv); without it the checklist highlight finds the control that writes the step's check channel. phases: the flight phases (mission.phase) a checklist is for; it opens at the start, and as the crew comes back aboard Columbia, in one. Eagle's are in lm_checklists.json.

steps.text: Watch the S-IVB/IU: TLI is automatic at the GO-for-TLI TIG
TLI ignition
TLI cutoff: verify apogee beyond the Moon (V82E)
CSM/LV SEP: transposition, docking and LM extraction
UP TLM CM - ACCEPT, in P00, for the ground's uplink
Mission Control: request the PAD (P27 takes the state vector and the P30 loads: UPLINK ACTY)
UP TLM CM - BLOCK
V37E 30E - P30 External Delta-V
Verify TIG (N33), PRO; verify N81 DV, PRO; check N42, PRO
P52 option 1, the preferred REFSMMAT (IMU realign)
CMC MODE - AUTO
V37E 40E - P40 SPS Thrusting
V50N18 flashing: PRO to maneuver to burn attitude
DELTA-V THRUST A - NORMAL
DELTA-V THRUST B - NORMAL
At TIG-5 s V99N40 flashing: PRO for engine on
Monitor V16N40 (TFI, VG, DV) - SPS cutoff
DELTA-V THRUST A and B - OFF
Trim N85 residuals with the THC, then PRO
Request LOI PAD ~8 h before pericynthion; fly with the SPS burn checklist
Lunar orbit confirmed
Request LOI-2 PAD and circularize
LM JETT before TEI (the ascent stage stays behind)
Request TEI PAD; fly it with the SPS burn checklist
Transearth coast
Request MCC PADs to trim the entry corridor (vacuum perigee ~37 km)
CM/SM SEP (15 min before entry interface)
V37E 61E - P61 Entry preparation
SCS ATT SOURCE - CMC (auto bank guidance)
ELS LOGIC - ON
ELS AUTO
0.05 g: P64 entry guidance
Drogues at 24,000 ft
Mains at 10,000 ft
Splashdown
At the LEB (SEAT): OPTICS ZERO - OFF, MODE - CMC
V37E 52E - P52 IMU realign
V04N06: V22E option E (1 PREF 2 NOM 3 REFS 4 LS); PRO
V06N22 new gimbal angles, MG under 70: PRO, coarse align
V50N25 00015: PRO for two stars (00405: roll heads down)
Star 1: PRO at V01N70; OPTICS MAN, centre it, MARK
Star 2: OPTICS CMC, PRO at V01N70; MAN, centre, MARK
V06N05 star angle difference under 0.02: PRO
V06N93 torquing angles: PRO to torque the gyros
V50N25 00014: V37E 00E; OPTICS MODE - CMC
